title: Estimate false positive density and vessel detection recall using AIS-aligned analysis
description: Estimate false positives using 'false positive density' (false positives per unit area) by analyzing large-area imagery in low-AIS-activity regions, far from shore, and in countries with good AIS use/reception. For recall, identify AIS-equipped vessels with positions within <2 minutes of SAR acquisition that should have appeared, and compute detection recall as a function of vessel length and spacing to nearest AIS vessel. Use this to support downstream AIS matching likelihood terms.

inputs.filters: low AIS activity, far from shore

outputs.recall_curve: Recall as function of vessel size and spacing
